requirement:
A successful source read records the mapped node's identity and the fingerprint
of the supplied contents under
{cite}`requirements.sdk.sources.provider_observations`. Direct tracked reads
record when returning the contents; agent reads record when delivering them.
Failures record no successful observation.

The dependency becomes stale when that node's fingerprint changes. The source
mapping cannot return an untracked successful read. Calling the standalone
outline parser directly records no graph dependency; a tracked node read must
enclose its use when its contents contribute to an assessment.
rationale:
The reviewed tests cover each obligation in `requirements.sdk.graph.validation-context.read_source.inputs`.

**Direct tracked reads (record the node identity and content fingerprint when returning).** `crates/trust-but-verify/src/agent/project_sources.rs#mod[tests]/fn[direct_source_reads_preserve_mapping_errors_and_record_only_successful_returns]` asserts three things after a successful `read_source`:
- The dependency list is exactly `[Dependency::Node(source-node, returned.fingerprint())]`.
- The mapped node identity is `source-node`.
- The fingerprint is that of the returned contents.

The same test covers the failure cases:
- An unknown resource and an unknown selector both give a mapping error and leave `dependencies()` empty.
- A failing provider read also leaves `dependencies()` empty.
- No read reaches the domain for the mapping failures.

The mapping's tracked reads are also checked indirectly. The mapping cannot return a successful read without a recorded dependency, because the only successful read in the test adds exactly one dependency.

**Staleness.** The same direct test finishes a record, asserts `is_current` is true, then changes the domain text and asserts `is_current` is false. `crates/trust-but-verify/src/agent/project_sources.rs#mod[tests]/fn[deterministic_source_reads_reuse_saved_results]` asserts `Dependency::Node(node, Content::Text("first").fingerprint())`. It also checks that a changed source gives new output.

**Agent reads (record when delivering).**
- `crates/trust-but-verify/src/agent/tests.rs#fn[source_tools_forward_arguments_and_present_discovery_and_read_results]` asserts that a `read_source` delivery carries exactly one `Dependency::Node` whose fingerprint value is the selector given to the observation callback. This is checked for no selector, an empty selector and `fn[chosen]`.
- `crates/trust-but-verify/src/agent/tests.rs#fn[source_read_pages_retain_text_and_dependencies_without_another_read]` asserts that the paged deliveries carry the original snapshot's dependency, and that the callback ran once.
- `crates/trust-but-verify/src/agent/tests.rs#fn[cached_selected_source_reads_record_exact_delivered_contents_and_errors_add_no_input]` asserts that the recorded fingerprint is the exact selected contents. A failing read of `fn[missing]` adds no input, so the final dependencies hold only the one successful observation.
- `crates/trust-but-verify/src/agent/tests.rs#fn[source_tools_keep_search_discovery_separate_from_delivered_source_reads]` asserts one observation after search plus read.
- `crates/trust-but-verify/src/agent/tests.rs#fn[source_reads_track_optional_dependencies_and_empty_searches_remain_discovery]` covers both a callback that records a dependency and one that does not. The record's dependencies and staleness match each case.

**Standalone outline parser records no dependency.** `crates/trust-but-verify/src/agent/tests.rs#fn[source_reads_track_optional_dependencies_and_empty_searches_remain_discovery]` calls `factory.analysis.parse` directly and asserts that `ctx.dependencies()` is empty and the observation callback ran zero times.

The search tests also check that discovery without delivery records nothing, which supports the delivered-only recording. I found no unchecked obligation and no counterexample the tests would accept.
